Docs.summary: Represents the pixel data produced by an asynchronous read-pixels request.

remarks.format: An instance is passed to the callback supplied to `SKImage.RequestReadPixels` or `SKSurface.RequestReadPixels`. The result and the plane data it exposes are only valid for the duration of the callback; to keep the pixels beyond the callback, copy them with `ToArray`, `CopyPlaneTo`, `ToImage`, or `ToBitmap`. Accessing a disposed result throws <xref:System.ObjectDisposedException>.

The span that receives the plane pixels as tightly-packed rows.
Docs.summary: Copies the specified plane into the destination span, stripping any per-row transfer padding.

remarks.format: The destination stride is the packed row size (`SKImageInfo.RowBytes`). The span must be at least that stride multiplied by the image height; otherwise an <xref:System.ArgumentException> is thrown. An <xref:System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException> is thrown when <paramref name="planeIndex" /> is out of range.
